open MeasureTheory
def IsCoupling {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (γ : Measure (α × β)) (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) : Prop :=
  γ.fst = μ ∧ γ.snd = ν
definition_context: For a measure on a product of measurable spaces, fst and snd are its pushforwards under the first and second projection. The product measure assigns the product of the two marginal masses to measurable rectangles.

IsProbabilityMeasure is a Prop-valued typeclass stating that the measure has total mass one. IsCoupling γ μ ν is the conjunction of the two displayed pushforward equalities in the definition in the given Lean context.

    IsCoupling (μ.prod ν) μ ν
